sentences: I'm going to visit my parents tomorrow.
سأزور والديّ غدًا.
We're going to travel to Luxor next month.
سنسافر إلى الأقصر الشهر القادم.
What are you going to do tonight?
ماذا ستفعل الليلة؟
I think it will rain tomorrow.
أعتقد أنها ستمطر غدًا.
Don't worry, I'll help you.
لا تقلق، سأساعدك.
Would you like to have dinner with us?
هل تود تناول العشاء معنا؟
I'd love to, thank you!
يسعدني ذلك، شكرًا!
I'm afraid I can't. I'm busy on Thursday.
للأسف لا أستطيع. أنا مشغول يوم الخميس.
Let's meet at the café at six.
لنلتقِ في المقهى الساعة السادسة.
I hope I'll speak English well next year.
آمل أن أتحدث الإنجليزية جيدًا العام القادم.

grammar.intro_ar: «سـ / سوف» لها في الإنجليزية شكلان: going to للخطة المقررة، و will للقرار اللحظي أو الوعد.

rows: A plan you already made: I'm going to visit my uncle on Friday.
A decision now, a promise, an offer or a guess: I'll help you. It will rain. · will not = won't

exercises.title: Exercise 2 · will ('ll) or going to?
items: 1) The phone is ringing. — I ___ answer it!
2) I ___ study medicine next year. I have a place at university.
3) It's cold. — I ___ close the window.
4) We ___ get married in June. We booked the hall.

exercises.title: Exercise 3 · Match each sentence with the best answer.
exercises.instructions: Match each sentence with the best answer: a) I'd love to! b) I'm afraid I can't. c) Yes, please. d) Good idea!
items: 3) Can you come on Friday? (you are busy)
4) Would you like to come to my wedding?

items: 3) هل تود أن تأتي إلى حفلتي؟

write_speak: Write & Speak — Write 6 sentences about your plans for next week, then write a short message inviting a friend somewhere.
other: Example: Next week I'm going to be busy. On Sunday I'm going to start a new course. On Tuesday I'm going to visit my sister. … Message: Hi Ali! Would you like to watch the match with me on Friday? Let's meet at the café at eight. See you!
